changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/11806-login-server-unreachable.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/README.md` → `packages/app-shell/README.md` — edited by this change

  > `packages/app-shell/README.md` documents the two new states in its sign-up table. Its `useSignUpOffer` recipe for hosts now asks `decideSignUpOffer` only once the read has answered, and answers `unreachable` for a failed read.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `2dbe5f533` (merge-base with origin/main): 8 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 610 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (631 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/38946050065)

**Checklist**
- **Form:**
  - Draft → `main`, assignee `os-sales`.
  - The first line is `Fixes #12705`, and the second is `Clause-②: yes`, as the claim `6219595266` declares.

- **The premise, re-measured first, as the ruling asked:** Setup › Users no longer cuts at 1024 px since objectui#12606 put the description on its own line. The cut still reproduces in the one-row posture (HotCRM Opportunities: 154 of 284 px) and on Setup › Packages (374 of 428 px). The fold lives in the header, so it covers both postures. That is the ruling's "build the fold for the posture that still cuts", recorded under `deviations`.
- **Rulings, as bound:**
  - **One header, one fold:** `ConsolePageHeader` measures its own width (a `ResizeObserver` plus a pass after each render), folds before the title or description is cut, and unfolds only once the text would still fit, so it cannot flip-flop. No viewport reading.
  - **The primary is declared, never inferred:** the list's New, else the toolbar action authored `variant: 'primary'` (Setup › Users keeps Invite User). The "primary by row position" ablation went red.
  - **`actions: React.ReactNode` keeps working:** a caller that passes no `foldedActions` keeps today's behaviour at every width; the CONTROL pins it.
  - **The ⋯ menu:** on a list it is the toolbar `action:bar`'s one overflow menu, so folded schema actions keep their capability, visible and disabled gates and their run path. Import, Add to favorites and Reset view join it as host callbacks. Setup › Packages and the object data page build a new menu from the existing primitives.
- **Screenshots, read by the seat:** Opportunities at 1024 px before (description cut to "Sales opportunities a…") and after (whole, with New labelled and Import · Update Stage · Add to favorites in the ⋯ menu); Setup › Users at 1024 px light and dark and 1280 px light and dark (three labelled actions, nothing folded); Setup › Users at 680 px folded; Setup › Packages at 1024 px folded. On the never-merged `claude/issue-12705-evidence` at `59aec88`. Sent to the maintainer at 2026-10-16T18:18Z.
- **Tests:**
  - New pins: `PageHeader.actionsFold-12705.test.tsx` (7) and `ObjectView.headerFold-12705.test.tsx` (6). Five ablations, each red. A sixth guard (the fold held off while a deep link was armed) stayed green under ablation, and the dev removed it as unneeded rather than keep code no test needs. A `?runAction=` deep link still runs exactly once, pinned.
  - Full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite on `5c886c9`: 1,468 files, 13,832 tests passed, 0 failed. The two later commits (Packages, the object data page, the changeset) ran 117 targeted app-shell files (1,256 tests) and the 16 console test files that reach these components (337 tests), all green. CI runs the full set on this head.
  - type-check, the app-shell and console builds, eslint on touched files (0 errors), the i18n checks including designer parity, line citations and changeset presence: all exit 0.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell` minor, user-facing prose.
- **Contract faces:** one optional prop on the exported `ConsolePageHeaderProps`, covered by `Clause-②: yes`. The `TIER_DEFAULT` contract review follows this record.
- **CI:** running at this record. Landing waits for green.

**Rulings**
1. **How the header learns what folds: A, as built.** One optional node, `foldedActions`, carrying the page's folded face. B (a `primaryAction` node beside `actions`) cannot turn an opaque `actions` node into menu items. C (structured items with a primary flag) would need a new `@object-ui/components` export or a copy of `action:bar`'s execute path to draw schema actions as menu items. A is the smallest declared shape that keeps one run path. Its weakness on the AI-error axis (a caller could leave an action out of its folded set) is answered by building the list's menu from the same action list its row draws, and the `ObjectView` pins assert the menu's contents.
2. **The contract conflict: A, as dispatched.** The relay is refused from the dev's container, so the seat opened the PR and relayed the report.
3. **Files beyond the claim's list:** `ObjectDataPage.tsx` is a caller that passes `actions` (two, cut at 800 px), inside the claim's "the header's callers only where the fold needs them". `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` gains one app-shell-internal string, `engine.packages.moreActions` (en and zh); it is not an `@object-ui/i18n` key and widens no published type. `packages/app-shell/README.md` documents the new prop (AGENTS.md #2). All accepted.
4. **"Above Share / Delete":** on a list header the page's own menu holds Add to favorites and Reset view; Share and Delete belong to the record page's `page:header`. Folding above the list's own entries is the card's intent. Accepted.
5. **`declaredPrimaryToolbarAction`** is a module export of `ObjectView.tsx` only; `views/index.ts` and the package entry name neither it nor anything new (measured on current `main`). One new `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning comes with it, as with the file's other exported helpers. Accepted.
6. **Out of scope, not filed:** an `action:bar` overflow member's `properties.params` is not evaluated. That is objectui#11638's existing limit, which a folded toolbar action shares with today's spill past `maxVisible`.
